rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with secure access to N Lobby school portal data through browser-based authentication and cookie management, built by minagishl using TypeScript with Puppeteer for automated login and tRPC client integration. The implementation offers interactive browser login that opens a window for manual authentication, comprehensive school data retrieval including news, announcements, required courses with progress tracking, and dual calendar support for both personal and school events, with built-in debugging tools and multi-user support for students, staff, and parents. Serves educational institutions using N High School Group's portal system, students and parents needing programmatic access to academic information, and developers building educational workflow automation with proper session management and NextAuth.js cookie handling.
